data.topic: developer lifecycle best practices with AI software factory
data.input_summary: Research and analyze best practices for AI-augmented software development lifecycle, mapping to software factory patterns (codebase intelligence, orchestration, quality verification, human-AI trust) with reference to the Gauntlet SF-2026-02 challenge.

constraints.value: Python/Shell orchestration pipeline with MCP servers, SQLite (epics.db, run-state.db), OpenMemory, Claude Code as primary agent runtime
Existing skill system (ship, research, presearch, draft-plans, run-stories, merge-worktree, etc.) with artifact chain contract
Gauntlet SF-2026-02 challenge constraints: 3 engineers, 60 days, 7 products, 3 languages, 80% CI pass on first run, nothing ships without human review
